items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: I happened to meet Scott Muny’s brother, anyway introduced us to Hillary Lipsitz

ctx.x: Oh that’s so interesting. Wow. You had to go through the process. The deadline loomed.

Yes it sure did. Many deadlines loomed. But the funniest one really, Pepsi Cola, now they had [sings] come alive, you’re in Pepsi generation. Joanie Sommers singing a nice swinging tune. But it was the early ‘60s and the people that were getting married and having kids really didn’t grow up on that music. They grew up on the early Welk stuff. And so I spoke to several music houses about doing it. I wasn’t singing a lot of jingles. I didn’t really have that jingly sound as a soloist. But I did talk to them about…
“Pepsi the generous one” which got to be known around the halls of BBDO as “Peppy the generous swan.”
